BiblicalUsage: Twelfth, the twelfth foundation of the New Jerusalem is garnished with amethyst, the last stone in the wall of the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the city God builds is finished down to the twelfth stone, and the last foundation matters as much as the first.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
